headline: Cyberattack takes meteor-tracking nonprofit offline for weeks
summary: Two outlets report a cyberattack that has taken the International Meteor Organization out of action, with several weeks of disruption expected. One outlet's text attributes the severity to ageing infrastructure; the other reports the outage without naming a cause.
